old.suzanne-giesemann:
Suzanne Giesemann is an evidential medium, spiritual teacher and author. Before this work she was a US Navy officer, reaching the rank of Commander and serving as a commanding officer and as aide to the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff; she also holds a master's degree in National Security Affairs. Her move from military life to mediumship is told in her memoir Messages of Hope and in the documentary of the same name, and her book Wolf's Message became a second documentary in 2025.

She teaches evidential mediumship and what she calls The Awakened Way, a path of living in conscious connection with higher guidance. Her methods include the BLESS ME Method for connecting with higher consciousness and the short SIP of the Divine meditation, and she shares channelled messages from a group of guides she calls Sanaya. She has written more than a dozen books, including The Awakened Way, Making the Afterlife Connection and Always Connected. She teaches through self-paced video courses on her own school and on The Shift Network, a free app with daily messages, a monthly live gathering, Hemi-Sync recordings and a large YouTube channel.
old.john-douillard:
Dr. John Douillard is a chiropractor and Ayurvedic practitioner who has taught Ayurveda for around forty years. A former professional athlete, he was director of player development for the New Jersey Nets basketball team, and his first book, Body, Mind, and Sport, set out an approach to exercise built on nasal breathing, ease and body type. He founded LifeSpa in Boulder, Colorado, which runs an Ayurvedic clinic and publishes his weekly articles and videos.

His teaching brings classical Ayurvedic ideas together with modern research: the doshas and emotional body types, daily and seasonal routines, pranayama and nasal breathing, Ayurvedic self-massage (abhyanga), yoga and meditation. He shares much of this freely on his YouTube channel and his podcast, Ayurveda Meets Modern Science, and has written seven books, including The Encyclopedia of Ayurvedic Massage. He also teaches self-paced Ayurveda courses on The Shift Network.
old.helen-liang:
Master Helen Liang is a teacher of Tai Chi, Qigong and Chinese internal martial arts with more than thirty years of teaching experience. She began training in China in 1976 and is a direct inheritor of the Emei lineage of Wushu from her father, Grandmaster Shou-Yu Liang. She is vice president of the SYL Wushu Taiji Qigong Institute, the family school in Richmond, near Vancouver, Canada, and holds 8th-degree rankings from two international Wushu organisations.

She teaches Tai Chi forms including the 24, 13-posture and 8-posture forms, the flowing internal art of Liu He Ba Fa (Water Style), Qigong and martial-arts philosophy rooted in Yin and Yang and the Yi Jing. With her father she wrote and hosted a 130-episode instructional Tai Chi television series for Canadian television, and she has made many instructional videos for YMAA. Her teaching is patient and detailed, breaking forms into clear steps with attention to alignment, breath and calm focus. She teaches classes at the institute and online, and has recorded several self-paced Tai Chi and Liu He Ba Fa courses with The Shift Network.
old.elayne-kalila-doughty:
Elayne Kalila Doughty is a teacher of the Divine Feminine mysteries who holds a master's degree and trained as a marriage and family therapist. She is an ordained priestess of the 13 Moon Mystery School, an Avalonian lineage, and of the Rosa Mystica Mystery School, and before her spiritual work she wrote and directed theatre with prison inmates and ran programmes for women in difficult circumstances. In 2014 she founded the Priestess Presence Temple, an online sisterhood that has grown to tens of thousands of women.

As founder and dean of the Priestess Presence mystery schools, she trains and ordains women in the role of the modern-day priestess through ritual, ceremony, archetypes, shadow work and embodied practice. Much of her recent teaching centres on Mary Magdalene and the myrrhophores, the scent-priestess lineages of anointing with holy oils. She teaches through self-paced courses, year-long online initiations, pilgrimages and retreats, hosts The RED Podcast, and created the Magdalene Rose Oracle deck. Her Magdalene courses are also available on The Shift Network.
old.penelope-smith:
Penelope Smith is an American teacher of animal communication who has worked professionally in the field since the 1970s and named it 'interspecies telepathic communication'. She holds bachelor's and master's degrees in the social sciences and trained in human counselling and holistic bodywork before turning her lifelong ability to understand animals into a profession. Her students call her the grandmother of interspecies communication, and many of today's professional animal communicators began with her courses.

She teaches that everyone is born able to communicate mind to mind with other species, and that this ability can be remembered through presence, receptivity and practice. Her books Animal Talk, When Animals Speak and Animals in Spirit are classics of the field, the last on animals' experience of death and the afterlife. She founded and edited Species Link magazine, formulated a code of ethics for animal communicators in 1990, and started the Animal Communicators Coalition for Animal Welfare. She now teaches through online courses, including on The Shift Network, and through audio courses and recorded seminars, and no longer offers private consultations.
old.wendy-de-rosa:
Wendy De Rosa is an intuitive energy healer, teacher and author who works with sensitive and empathic people. She founded the School of Intuitive Studies, where her year-long Energy Healing and Intuition Training teaches students to read and clear their own energy system through the chakras, strengthen their intuition and practise as intuitive healers. She also runs The Sanctuary, a monthly membership of live group healings and meditations, and hosts The Wendy De Rosa Sessions podcast.

Her teaching centres on grounding, energetic boundaries and the four intuitive pathways of clairsentience, claircognizance, clairaudience and clairvoyance, taught through guided practices rather than theory alone. She is the author of Becoming an Empowered Empath, Expanding Your Heart: Awakening Through Four Stages of a Spiritual Opening and Energy Healing Through the Chakras. She has taught for Kripalu, Omega and Blue Spirit, and has led many self-paced and live courses for empaths on The Shift Network.
old.roger-jahnke:
Dr. Roger Jahnke is a teacher of qigong and tai chi and a doctor of Chinese medicine, with more than three decades of clinical practice in acupuncture and traditional Chinese medicine and ten research and cultural trips to China. He founded the Institute of Integral Qigong and Tai Chi (IIQTC) in Santa Barbara, California, in 2000 and is its director and lead trainer. The institute and its faculty have trained thousands of qigong and tai chi teachers and practice leaders, now largely through online modular certification.

His approach, which he calls Integral Qigong, brings together gentle movement, breath practice, self-applied massage and meditation, and he developed Tai Chi Easy, a simplified practice designed for beginners and community classes. He is the author of The Healer Within and The Healing Promise of Qi, which draws on more than twenty traditional and modern forms of qigong and tai chi. He teaches self-paced and live programmes on The Shift Network and has taught at centres including Esalen and Omega.
old.jeffrey-thompson:
Dr. Jeffrey Thompson is a composer, sound researcher and teacher who founded the Center for Neuroacoustic Research in Carlsbad, California. Trained as a chiropractor and with a fine-arts background in music, he has spent several decades studying how sound, rhythm and vibration affect brainwave states and awareness. He composes neuroacoustic soundtracks that use brainwave entrainment, including his own phase-modulated binaural beats and three-dimensional sound processing, and worked on releasing the NASA Voyager space-sound recordings.

His recordings for meditation, relaxation and creativity are sold through Scientific Sounds, and several audio programmes, such as Brainwave Symphony and Gamma Meditation System, have been published by Sounds True. On his YouTube channel he gives long-form live talks on consciousness, the default mode network, intuition and sacred geometry, and leads Global Mind Link group sound sessions. He teaches psychoacoustics and quantum acoustics on The Shift Network.
old.martha-collard:
Martha Collard is a gong master and the founder of Red Doors Studio in Wong Chuk Hang, Hong Kong, a studio given over to meditation gongs, labyrinth walking and Kundalini yoga. She came to this work after three decades in management consulting, having been the youngest partner worldwide at TASA, a Swiss executive search firm, before setting up her own consultancy in 1992. She was the founding chairman of the Yoga Society of Hong Kong.

She trained with Gong Master Don Conreaux, and has also studied singing bowls, overtoning with Mark van Tongeren, voice with Chanara Richmond and integral sound with the Svaram Sound Institute, as well as flumie (friction mallet) playing with Bear Love. At Red Doors she runs small, hands-on gong trainings in three levels, from playing for yourself to leading sessions for others and playing alongside other musicians, and she teaches across Asia and in New York. Online she teaches gong meditation and gong playing through The Shift Network and leads free New Moon gong livestreams. She has spoken at TEDx Hong Kong and the Global Wellness Summit.
old.ramsay-taum:
Kumu Ramsay Taum is a Native Hawaiian cultural practitioner and teacher, and the founder of the Life Enhancement Institute of the Pacific. Mentored and trained by respected kūpuna (elders), he practises and teaches hoʻoponopono, the Hawaiian process of reconciliation and forgiveness, as well as lomi haha (body alignment) and Kaihewalu Lua, the Hawaiian martial art. He was educated at The Kamehameha Schools, attended the United States Air Force Academy and holds a degree in public administration from the University of Southern California.

Much of his work brings Hawaiian values such as aloha, pono and kuleana into business, tourism, planning and community life, as a speaker, adviser and facilitator. He leads group and one-to-one hoʻoponopono sessions, in-person immersions in Lua, hoʻoponopono and the Aloha Way, and talks at churches, conferences and TEDx. On The Shift Network he teaches The Sacred Path of Aloha, a course in hoʻoponopono, HA breathing, ancestral remembrance, chant and ceremony.
old.david-crow:
David Crow is an American herbalist, acupuncturist, aromatherapist and author who has worked in natural medicine for more than 40 years. He was among the first Westerners to train and be licensed in Chinese medicine, and he studied Ayurvedic and Tibetan medicine through traditional internships in Nepal and India. His book In Search of the Medicine Buddha tells the story of those years in the Himalayas, where he studied with Tibetan physicians and meditation teachers. He founded Floracopeia, which works with small-scale growers and distillers around the world to produce essential oils and botanical products, and he has travelled widely for ethnobotanical research.

David's teaching joins plant knowledge with meditation and ecological spirituality. His courses look at the chakras and the body's inner landscape through Tibetan and yogic traditions, the art of blending essential oils, and heart-centred meditation that uses the rhythm of the heartbeat. He has taught across the United States, Canada and Europe for more than 25 years, and since 2015 has been a regular teacher on The Shift Network, where he also founded and hosted its annual Plant Medicine Summit. He is based in Grass Valley, California, and teaches mainly online.
old.puma-fredy-quispe-singona:
Puma Fredy Quispe Singona is an Andean medicine carrier from Chinchero, near Cusco in Peru, and a keeper of the Rainbow Lineage traditions of the Inca people of his village. He began training as a child with his grandfather, the late Don Maximo, after being struck by lightning at the age of six, and he has also studied the lineages of huachuma on the Peruvian coast and of ayahuasca with the Shipibo people of the Amazon. From the age of 15 he has spoken at international gatherings and has led meetings for spiritual and young Indigenous leaders.

Puma teaches Andean cosmology, ceremony and the mesa, the portable altar of the Andes, with a deep respect for Pachamama. He founded the Noqan Kani Global Community Center in Chinchero, where local people and visitors can learn Andean ways and nature-based wisdom, and runs online mesa programmes from there. He co-founded Pumadventures, which leads groups to sacred sites in Peru, and he has taught many self-paced courses on The Shift Network on Andean shamanic practice, spirit animals and the Chakana, the Andean cross.
old.banafsheh-sayyad:
Banafsheh Sayyad is a Persian sacred dancer, choreographer and teacher, and the founder of Dance of Oneness®, a path of embodied spirituality she created in 2005. Born in Iran into a family of performing artists, she holds a Master of Fine Arts in dance and choreography from UCLA, where she also taught Persian dance. Her spiritual path led her to the Gurdjieff Work, the Sufi tradition and the Divine Feminine, and her training in Chinese medicine, Tai Chi and Qigong brought an understanding of meridians and the chakras into her movement work. She performs with her company NAMAH and made the dance film In the Fire of Grace with Andrew Harvey, tracing Rumi's journey of the soul.

Dance of Oneness draws on Sufi whirling, Persian dance, flamenco and contemporary movement, combined with meditation, breath and wisdom teachings, including the poetry of Rumi. She teaches online and in person, with workshops at centres such as Esalen, Kripalu and Omega, a library of video courses and a certification programme for those who want to teach. Her book Dance of Oneness: Embody Love and Luminosity to Transform Your Life, with forewords by Anne Baring and Andrew Harvey, sets out the method as a practical guide.
old.stephen-dinan:
Stephen Dinan is the founder and chief executive of The Shift Network, which he started in 2010 to bring spiritual teachers, healers and thinkers to a global audience through online summits, courses and trainings. He studied human biology at Stanford University and East-West psychology at the California Institute of Integral Studies. Before The Shift Network he helped create and directed the Esalen Institute's Center for Theory & Research, and as director of membership and marketing at the Institute of Noetic Sciences he led the Shift in Action programme and the One Minute Shift media series.

His own teaching joins spiritual practice with purpose, leadership and social change. In Sacred America, Sacred World he sets out a hopeful, transpartisan vision of a nation and world shaped by spiritual values, and he edited the anthology Radical Spirit, which gathered writing from a younger generation of spiritual voices. He has spoken at the World Cultural Forum in China and the Alliance for a New Humanity in Costa Rica, among other gatherings, and today he mentors spirit-led entrepreneurs and teachers on bringing their work to a wider audience. He lives in San Rafael, California.
old.davina-mackail:
Davina MacKail is a feng shui consultant and shamanic teacher with more than 35 years of experience. She first trained as a nurse, then began shamanic practice in the 1990s, deepening it through a long apprenticeship with Alex Stark in New York and through the Pachakuti Mesa tradition of don Oscar Miro-Quesada. She trained professionally in feng shui and geomancy, and for nearly two decades has led pilgrimages to Peru with the Q'ero teacher Puma Fredy Quispe Singona. She was the first to teach shamanism at the College of Psychic Studies in London and is a co-founder of the Ayni Foundation.

Her work treats the home as a living mirror of the people in it, combining classical feng shui and space clearing with shamanic ceremony, astrology, tarot and the Gene Keys. She offers online and in-person consultations and mentoring, sends a fortnightly Moon Report with guided shamanic journeys at each full moon, and teaches courses, including an introductory feng shui course for Hay House and Shamanic Feng Shui on The Shift Network. She is the author of Feng Shui Made Easy and The Dream Whisperer, both published by Hay House.
old.eluna-noelle:
Eluña Noelle is a psycho-spiritual teacher whose work brings together psychology, ancient wisdom, mythology, consciousness and intuitive practice. She describes heightened intuitive awareness from early childhood. She began college at sixteen, studying pre-medicine at the University of Washington, before moving to psychology, human development and transpersonal psychology at The Evergreen State College. She later earned a master's degree in Montessori education and certified as a Psychosynthesis life coach. She began reading the Akashic Records privately for friends and clients, and since her first public channelling in January 2024 has built a large online following.

Her teaching moves between study and direct practice, using meditation, breathwork, guided writing, voice, contemplation and embodiment, with a particular focus on ancient Egyptian archetypes and the mystery traditions. She runs The Circle, an online membership with monthly meditations and live teachings, and a year-long Living Mystery School, and offers self-paced courses including one on accessing the Akashic Records. She teaches retreats at Omega Institute and the Art of Living Retreat Center and leads sacred journeys in Egypt. In late 2026 she said publicly that she is moving away from trance channelling towards teaching.
old.miranda-macpherson:
Miranda Macpherson is an interfaith minister and spiritual teacher who offers a feminine approach to surrender and nondual realisation, based on a practice she calls Ego Relaxation. Born in Australia, she trained at the Western Australian Academy of Performing Arts before moving to the United Kingdom. At 26, at the request of her teacher Rabbi Joseph Gelberman, she founded the OneSpirit Interfaith Foundation in London, where over a decade she trained and ordained more than six hundred interfaith ministers and spiritual counsellors. In 2005, after a period of practice in Sri Ramana Maharshi's cave in south India, she settled in the San Francisco Bay Area, where she lives in San Rafael.

Her teaching draws on Sri Ramana Maharshi, A Course in Miracles and the Diamond Approach, and combines meditation, self-inquiry, mantra and devotion with psychological integration. She leads the Living Grace Global Sangha, home retreats on Zoom and in-person retreats in California, Europe and the Bahamas, and teaches regular courses on The Shift Network. She is the author of The Way of Grace and Boundless Love (first published as Miranda Holden), created the Cultivating Grace card deck, and has recorded two mantra albums.
old.mary-sise:
Mary Sise is a licensed clinical social worker in New York State with more than 35 years of clinical experience, and for over two decades she has worked with energy psychology, the family of methods that pairs focused attention with tapping on acupressure points. She is a past president of the Association for Comprehensive Energy Psychology (ACEP), holds its diplomate in comprehensive energy psychology, and has presented at its yearly conference for many years. She is co-author, with Sheila Sidney Bender, of The Energy of Belief.

Her teaching centres on her own form of Emotional Freedom Techniques (EFT), which combines intention, breath, tapping and eye movements, alongside meditation, sound and chakra work, with the aim of releasing limiting beliefs and living in line with the soul's guidance. Her later work, the Soul Weaving Process, explores how split-off parts of the self can be brought back into wholeness, and she directs the Magdalena Healing programme. She teaches through recorded courses on The Shift Network and her own site, weekly free tapping groups, and a monthly mentorship for therapists, coaches and healers.
old.laura-koniver:
Dr. Laura Koniver is a physician who trained in conventional medicine and later turned to a holistic approach centred on grounding, the practice of making direct physical contact with the Earth. She is the author of The Earth Prescription (Reveal Press, 2020), which gathers grounding practices for each season and has been translated into several languages, and she has appeared in grounding documentaries including The Grounded, Heal for Free, Down to Earth and The Earthing Movie. She is also a painter and writes a regular column for MaryJanesFarm magazine.

Her teaching explains grounding in plain terms: why the body's electrical connection with the ground matters to her, simple ways to ground indoors and outdoors in every season, and how to fold the practice into daily life. Under the name The Intuition Physician she shares hundreds of short teaching videos, guided grounding meditations and online classes on chakras and intuition, and she leads small in-person grounding retreats in the eastern United States. She also teaches online courses and free events on The Shift Network.
old.maureen-hancock:
Maureen Hancock is a spirit medium, intuitive teacher and author based in the Bridgewater area of Massachusetts. Before working full time as a medium she was a litigation manager, and for more than 25 years she has focused on helping people talk more openly about death, dying and grief. She wrote The Medium Next Door: Adventures of a Real-Life Ghost Whisperer and was the subject of the Style Network documentary Psychic in Suburbia (2011). She volunteers with hospice, sits with bereaved parents and has assisted families and law enforcement in missing-person cases.

Her teaching centres on intuition and spirit communication: recognising signs from loved ones who have died, clearing what she calls the clutter that blocks connection, and testing and trusting intuitive impressions. She runs Maureen Hancock University, an online school of self-paced semesters with meditations and lessons, and teaches workshops for law enforcement, medical professionals and the public. Her Postcards from Heaven evenings of group readings tour New England, and she leads Soul Shift retreats on Cape Cod and in Costa Rica that combine meditation, breathwork, intuitive exercises and mediumship. She founded The Zen Loft, a yoga and wellness centre in Bridgewater, and teaches courses on The Shift Network.
old.sue-frederick:
Rev. Sue Frederick is an ordained Unity minister, numerologist and intuitive based in Scottsdale, Arizona, who has studied numerology since 1980. She also works as a past-life and between-lives soul regression therapist, and describes herself as a channel for angelic guidance and for messages from departed loved ones. Before this work she was a corporate vice president and magazine editor, led Outward Bound survival courses and taught at the University of Colorado and Naropa University. Her outlook was shaped by the early death of her husband and by what she calls three shared-death experiences.

She teaches what she calls Sacred Numerology: reading the numbers in a birth date as a map of soul purpose, relationships and timing cycles, alongside angelic guidance, meditation and sacred writing. Her books include I See Your Dream Job, I See Your Soul Mate, Bridges to Heaven, Through a Divine Lens, the Angel Up! series and Angels & Numbers. She teaches live Zoom courses and self-paced video classes, runs a Patreon group, hosts the Mystical Conversations podcast and YouTube channel, and teaches on The Shift Network. She is an honorary board member of Helping Parents Heal.
old.ibrahim-jaffe:
Dr. R. Ibrahim Jaffe is a physician and a teacher in the Shadhiliyya Sufi tradition. He received his medical degree from the University of Illinois and practised medicine in Arizona, Hawaii and California before devoting his work to spiritual teaching. In 1996 he became a student of the Sufi master Sidi Muhammad al-Jamal ar-Rifa'i, and after years of training he was given authorisation (ijaza) to teach and the title Murshid Murabbi Ruhi, a guide and caretaker of the soul.

He founded the Jaffe Institute in 2000, which grew into the Institute of Spiritual Healing and the University of Sufism, where he is founding Chancellor, and he co-leads the Shadhiliyya Ma'rifa community through the Ma'rifa Foundation. His teaching centres on Sufism as a path of divine love: remembrance of God (dhikr), purification of the heart, the Divine Names and the stations of the heart, together with a method of spiritual inquiry he developed called APIIR-TB. He gives a free weekly teaching series, Wisdom Wednesdays, leads Friday Jumu'ah teachings and monthly full moon dhikr online, and is the author of God's Way: Sufi Spiritual Healing. He is based in the Florida Keys.
old.donna-lozito:
Donna Lozito is an interspecies animal communicator and a nationally certified classical homeopath who has worked with people and their animal companions for several decades. She trained at the School of Homeopathy in New York and continued her studies in India and England with Farokh Master, Frederik Schroyens and Rajan Sankaran, and she has supervised and taken part in homeopathic provings with the American College of Homeopathy in Phoenix, Arizona. Her work with animals has taken her as far as Saudi Arabia, Dubai, Turkey and Israel, where she worked with camels.

Her approach brings together telepathic communication with animals, both living and in spirit, classical homeopathy and intuitive coaching, with an emphasis on listening, compassion and seeing from another being's point of view. She works with clients by Zoom and phone, offers a mentorship programme for people developing their own animal communication skills, and teaches live and recorded online classes on energy communication and the art of listening. She is the author of the children's book Sweet Dreams: The Talking Horse from Brooklyn, and has taught on The Shift Network, including in its animal communication certificate programme.
old.lydia-de-leon:
Dr. Lydia de León is a Greek architect and researcher who studies how places and buildings affect the people in them. She trained in architecture at the National Technical University of Athens, took an MSc in Sustainable Environmental Design at the Architectural Association in London, and completed a PhD in geobiology at the University of Ioannina on the effects of geophysical anomalies on living systems. For around fifteen years she has researched why ancient temples were built where they were, measuring earth fields, geometry, materials and celestial alignments at sacred sites.

With her partner, the architect Arturo Ponce de León, she co-founded Geophilia, a design studio and school with bases in Greece, Mexico and Spain that brings sacred geometry and building biology into architecture. She created the Healing Architecture approach and wrote The Power of Sacred Location, based on her doctoral research. She teaches online courses on the sacred science of ancient temples, runs the Return to the Temple membership and temple retreats with Arturo, is on the faculty of Resonance Academy, and teaches a live course, Ancient Temple Codes, on The Shift Network.
old.neil-douglas-klotz:
Neil Douglas-Klotz is an American-born scholar, writer, meditation teacher and musician who lives in Scotland. He works on the spirituality of the native Middle East and translates from Aramaic, Hebrew and Arabic, with a particular focus on the Aramaic words of Jesus. He has co-chaired the Mysticism Group of the American Academy of Religion, directs the Edinburgh Institute for Advanced Learning, and in 1982 co-founded the International Network for the Dances of Universal Peace. He is also a Sufi teacher in the lineage of Samuel L. Lewis, under the name Saadi.

His books include Prayers of the Cosmos, The Hidden Gospel, Original Meditation, Revelations of the Aramaic Jesus and The Aramaic Jesus Book of Days, alongside The Sufi Book of Life, Desert Wisdom and The Little Book of Sufi Stories, edited collections of Kahlil Gibran and a novel. He teaches through chant, breath, sacred movement and meditation as much as through texts, leading retreats and online events through the Abwoon Network, and has recorded four on-demand courses on the Aramaic Jesus for The Shift Network.
old.perdita-finn:
Perdita Finn is a writer and teacher who helps people build a working relationship with their ancestors and the dead. She has studied with Zen teachers, priests, spirit workers and healers, and apprenticed with the psychic Suzan Saxman, with whom she wrote The Reluctant Psychic. With her husband, the former Zen monk Clark Strand, she co-founded The Way of the Rose, a lay rosary fellowship centred on the divine feminine and on what they call ecology, not theology; their book The Way of the Rose tells its story.

Her teaching draws on animism, ancestor veneration and the older mother-centred traditions she explores in her books Take Back the Magic: Conversations with the Unseen World and Mothers of Magic: Summoning the Wisdom of Our Ancestors. She teaches through Zoom workshops, a year-long course called A Year of Living with the Dead, monthly gatherings for her Substack readers and self-paced courses on The Shift Network, using altars, ritual, oracles, dreamwork and prayer. She lives in the Catskill Mountains of New York.
old.raja-choudhury:
Raja Choudhury, known to his students as Rajada, is a teacher of Kundalini Shakti, Tantra and Kriya Yoga, and a documentary filmmaker. He trained as an architect at London's Architectural Association and worked as a digital creative director in London and New York, where a Kundalini awakening in 2006 changed the direction of his life. He moved to India and made films on wisdom traditions and spiritual teachers, including Spirituality in the Modern World with Ken Wilber and a film on his own teacher, Guruji Amritananda; The Quantum Indians won India's National Film Award in 2014, and America's First Guru, on Swami Vivekananda, was shown on PBS. He gave a TED talk on Indian wisdom in 2012.

His teaching draws on Shaiva and Shakta Tantra, Sri Vidya, the Vigyan Bhairav Tantra and Vedanta, explained alongside neuroscience and modern psychology, with breath, mantra and meditation practice at its heart. He encourages students to become their own guru. He teaches online courses on The Shift Network and runs A Thousand Suns Academy, which offers on-demand programmes and a monthly membership called The Path, and his long talks on Kundalini, Shiva and the third eye are widely watched on YouTube. He lives in Princeton, New Jersey.
old.william-bloom:
Dr. William Bloom is a British author and teacher of meditation, subtle energy and modern spirituality. Born in London in 1948, he was a novelist and a commissioning editor at Macmillan before spending two years on an off-grid spiritual retreat in the High Atlas Mountains of Morocco, recorded in his book The Sacred Magician. He later earned a doctorate in political psychology at the London School of Economics, where he also taught, and spent ten years teaching adults and teenagers with special needs. He co-founded the Alternatives programme at St James's Church, Piccadilly, has long taught at the Findhorn Foundation, and was for many years a trustee of Glastonbury Abbey.

He founded and leads the Spiritual Companions Trust, an educational charity that created the first Ofqual-registered vocational qualification in spirituality, and its current work brings spiritual wellbeing into schools. His teaching is practical and drawn from many traditions, centred on a daily meditation practice, working with subtle energy, psychic protection, and an approach to death and dying that is calm and unafraid. His books, translated into sixteen languages, include Psychic Protection, The Endorphin Effect, Working With Angels, Fairies and Nature Spirits and The Power of the New Spirituality. He teaches online through The Shift Network and Watkins Wisdom Academy.
old.david-gandelman:
David Gandelman is a meditation teacher and author who teaches meditation, energy awareness and intuitive development with a light, often humorous touch. He studied Western philosophy at Rutgers University, then spent time studying Eastern spiritual traditions while living in the Himalayas, and later directed a school for intuitive development and mysticism in Hawaii. He has taught meditation at Cornell University and for organisations such as NBC Universal and SAP, and his guided meditations are widely used on the Insight Timer app.

He founded Meditation School, an online membership and app with courses and daily meditations, and hosts the Meditation School, Energy Matters and Grounded Sleep podcasts. With Cody Edner he runs the Energy Matters Academy, which offers courses on seeing and reading energy, the intuitive chakras and kundalini, as well as in-person retreats, and with Michael Galyon he leads a year-long meditation teacher training. His book The 7 Energies of the Soul describes seven archetypal energies (creator, healer, warrior, lover, artist, explorer and master) with exercises and meditations for finding balance between them. On The Shift Network he teaches Third Eye Training, a course in intuition and energy reading.
old.christine-stevens:
Christine Stevens is a music therapist, author and drum circle facilitator who teaches drumming and the Native American-style flute as spiritual and sound-healing practices. She holds master's degrees in music therapy and social work, founded UpBeat Drum Circles, and has led drum circles for companies, communities, disaster survivors and refugee women, including the first drum circle peace training in northern Iraq. After more than a decade of singing Lakota prayer songs and taking part in Hanbleceya, she was adopted into a Native American family by Uncle Manny Eagle Elk Council Pipe Sandoval, and she is a pipe carrier for Women's Way Long Dance.

Her teaching uses hand drums, frame drums, voice, crystal bowls and flute, often played outdoors at sacred natural sites, with an emphasis on improvisation, ceremony and reciprocity with nature. She runs online courses and trainings, the monthly Global Rhythm Sangha, and a series of self-paced flute and drumming courses on The Shift Network. Her books include Music Medicine, The Healing Drum Kit, The Art and Heart of Drum Circles and The Nature Sutras. She is based in Encinitas, California.
old.tina-zion:
Tina Zion is an intuitive medium, author and teacher based in Indianapolis, Indiana, who describes herself as a fourth-generation intuitive. She worked for many years as a registered nurse with a specialty certification in mental health nursing, trained as a Gestalt counsellor at the Indianapolis Gestalt Institute, and holds a degree in communication and management. She is also certified in clinical hypnotherapy with a focus on past-life regression and trained with the Michael Newton Institute in Life Between Lives regression. She reached Reiki Master-Teacher level and taught Reiki for more than ten years.

Her teaching centres on developing intuition and on mediumship, including how a medium can help the deceased move on and work with spirit guides. She teaches online and in person, and has led courses in the United Kingdom, Europe, New Zealand, Australia, Canada and Mexico as well as at Omega Institute and Fellowships of the Spirit in the United States. Her books include The Reiki Teacher's Manual, Reiki and Your Intuition, and Healing Ghosts, Haunted Places, and Non-Human Beings, a training manual for mediums. She also offers recorded courses through her own website and The Shift Network.
old.rob-schwartz:
Rob (Robert) Schwartz is an American author and hypnotist who writes and teaches about pre-birth planning: the idea that we plan our lives, including our hardest challenges, as souls before we are born. He worked in the corporate world until 2003, when a session with a medium changed the direction of his life. He went on to spend years working with mediums and channels to explore the pre-birth plans of many people, and wrote three books on the subject, Your Soul's Plan, Your Soul's Gift and Your Soul's Love, which have been translated into more than twenty-five languages.

Since 2012 he has offered Between Lives Soul Regression sessions, a form of hypnosis in which a person revisits a past life and then speaks with a council of wise, loving guides about their current life plan. He is clear that he is neither a medium nor a channel himself. He teaches internationally, at venues including Kripalu, 1440 Multiversity and Hollyhock, and online through The Shift Network. With his wife, Liesel Fricke, who channels a group they call the Beings of Light, he leads online group regressions and Rise to the Path, a monthly membership and mentoring community.
old.viviane-chauvet:
Viviane Chauvet is a channel and teacher of what she presents as Arcturian wisdom, describing herself as an ambassador for the Arcturians, a star nation she says she works with directly. She trained in several energy-healing and intuitive methods, completing certifications with the ThetaHealing Institute, in Dolores Cannon's QHHT, with the HeartMath Institute and in the Unity Field Technique, and she has also studied Reiki and meditation. She has taught and spoken internationally for more than fifteen years and created Arcturian Energy Matrix Healing and the Arcturian Healing Arts Program.

She founded the Arcturian University, an online school where she leads a monthly two-hour master class, group meditations and community gatherings, alongside a free library of meditations and introductory talks. She also leads retreats at sacred sites, including in Sedona, Nepal, Germany and New Zealand, and has taught on The Shift Network. Her long guided meditations, such as the Rays of Creation series, are shared freely on YouTube, and her documentary An Arcturian Experience tells her own story. She co-hosts the Infinite Star Connections podcast and has contributed chapters to several anthologies, including The Way of the Initiate.
old.linda-star-wolf:
Linda Star Wolf is a shamanic teacher and the creator of Shamanic Breathwork, a ceremonial practice that combines cyclical breathing, chakra-attuned music, bodywork, art and group sharing. She began her working life as a therapist and counsellor in the 1970s and studied breathwork and consciousness with teachers including Ram Dass, Leonard Orr, Stanislav Grof and Jacquelyn Small. In the 1990s she trained with the Eupsychia Institute and studied the Wolf Clan teachings of the Seneca elder Twylah Nitsch, who adopted her as a spiritual granddaughter and gave her the name Star Wolf.

She founded the Venus Rising Association for Transformation and Venus Rising University, based on Dove Mountain in North Carolina, where students train through the Shamanic Healing Initiatory Process (S.H.I.P.) to become Shamanic Breathwork facilitators and shamanic ministers. With her husband, Nikólaus Wolf, she also leads Shamanic Mystery Tours to sacred sites in Egypt, Peru, Bali and elsewhere, and hosts small retreats in Portugal. She has written or co-written thirteen books, including Shamanic Breathwork, Visionary Shamanism, Shamanic Mysteries of Egypt with Nicki Scully, and The Aquarian Shaman, and she hosts The Aquarian Shaman broadcast. She teaches on The Shift Network.
old.joan-ranquet:
Joan Ranquet is an American animal communicator, energy worker and teacher who has worked with animals and their people professionally for around thirty years. She describes animal communication as a learnable skill rather than a rare gift, and her teaching centres on telepathic connection with animals, grounding and sensing the energy of a home, the chakras of dogs, cats and horses, EFT tapping for animals and their guardians, and keeping a connection with animals who have died. She lives on a small ranch in southern California with her horses, dogs and cats, which also serve as teaching partners for her students.

In 2009 she founded Communication With All Life University (CWALU), an online and in-person school offering courses and certification in animal communication, energy work, and nature and wildlife. Her books include Communication With All Life (Hay House), Energy Healing for Animals (Sounds True), Emotional Freedom Technique for Animals and Their Humans, co-written with Ellie Laks, and Animal Chakra Healing (Findhorn Press). She has given a TEDx talk on animals in transition, leads wildlife journeys to places such as Thula Thula in South Africa, and teaches self-paced courses on The Shift Network.
old.marion-gilbert:
Marion Gilbert is an American teacher of embodied awareness and the founder of the Somatic Enneagram. A registered physical therapist since 1978, she runs a physical therapy practice and movement studio in Grass Valley, California, and trained in craniosacral therapy and SomatoEmotional Release. She began working with the Enneagram in 2003, joined the core faculty of the Narrative Enneagram tradition in 2007, and remains adjunct faculty of The Narrative Enneagram. She also serves on the advisory board of the Enneagram Prison Project.

Her work treats the Enneagram as a map of the body as well as of thoughts and feelings. Students learn to notice how their personality type shows up as physical habits and reactions, using three practices she calls grounded presence, cultivating an inner observer and the deliberate placement of attention, with the aim of bringing the body, heart and mind into balance, which she calls three-centred awareness. She teaches the Somatic Enneagram through online training modules, a professional certification path and residential retreats in the United States, Europe and Egypt. She also leads a free weekly online meditation and appears on The Somatic Enneagram Podcast, and is preparing a new programme with The Shift Network.
old.lisa-rafel:
Lisa Rafel is an American spiritual teacher and sound healer known for Vocal Sound Healing™, a way of using the voice, chant and overtones for self-healing and for working with others. She came to teaching after careers as an actress, playwright, songwriter and producer, and has taught the use of vocal sound for more than thirty years. Her classes draw on guided meditation, prayer, energy exercises and psychic "seeing", influenced by Kabbalah and by Tibetan, Mongolian, ancient Egyptian and Native American practices, and she has sung at Chartres Cathedral, the Great Pyramid and the Sakya Monastery in Tibet.

She teaches live online in small groups: The Five Worlds, a two-day programme moving through five thresholds towards an integrated sense of self; Psychic Wisdom; Vocal Sound Healing classes; and small ongoing groups she calls pods. She is faculty at The Shift Network, the Globe Sound Healing Institute and Rancho La Puerta in Mexico, and runs Lisa's World, a low-cost membership library of her meditations, prayers and talks. Through her company Resonant Sounds she co-created Safe in the Arms of Love, a book and music set on bonding between parents and babies, with Gary Malkin and her husband David Surrenda.
old.silvia-nakkach:
Silvia Nakkach, also known by her spiritual name Saraswati Devi, is a Grammy-nominated musician, composer and vocalist who trained and worked as a music psychotherapist before devoting herself to the voice as a spiritual practice. She has studied North Indian classical singing, especially the Dhrupad style of raga, for around four decades, and for more than sixteen years she taught at the California Institute of Integral Studies in San Francisco, where she designed its Certificate in Sound, Voice and Music in the Healing Arts.

She founded the Vox Mundi Project, an international school of sound and the voice with bases in the San Francisco Bay Area and Brazil, and developed The Yoga of the Voice, a method that brings together deep listening, breath, chanting, raga, improvisation and shamanic medicine melodies. She teaches it through modular certificate trainings, retreats and online courses, including programmes on The Shift Network, and she has released many albums of devotional and ambient music. Her book Free Your Voice, written with Valerie Carpenter, offers more than a hundred vocal exercises for people with no musical training.
old.marguerite-mary-rigoglioso:
Marguerite Mary Rigoglioso is a scholar of ancient Mediterranean religion and a teacher of the Sacred Feminine, best known for her research on divine and virgin birth traditions and on Mother Mary and Mary Magdalene. She holds a PhD in Humanities and an MA in Philosophy and Religion from the California Institute of Integral Studies, trained in intuitive development at the Foundation for Spiritual Development, and taught religion and women's spirituality at several Bay Area universities before helping to set up an MA in Myth, Cosmology and the Sacred at Canterbury Christ Church University in England.

In 2012 she founded Seven Sisters Mystery School, through which she teaches the oracle and priestess traditions of the ancient world, the lineage of the Marys, the Pleiades and the faery realms. Her work combines historical scholarship with guided meditation, ceremony and oracular transmission, offered through on-demand courses, a monthly online membership called the Inner Sanctum Temple, and a six-month Mary and Magdalene priestess training. Her books include The Secret Life of Mother Mary, The Mystery Tradition of Miraculous Conception, and two academic studies, The Cult of Divine Birth in Ancient Greece and Virgin Mother Goddesses of Antiquity.
old.gemma-petherbridge:
Gemma Petherbridge is a British crystal healer, Akashic Records reader and teacher who grew up near Stonehenge and Avebury and says she has been psychic since childhood. After losing both her parents in her early twenties she turned away from a corporate career towards spiritual study, and over more than twenty years she has gathered a wide range of qualifications in crystal healing, energy work and related fields. In 2017 she started Conscience Crystals and then founded The Crystal Mystery School, an online academy that runs accredited trainings.

Her school teaches crystal healing certification, two levels of Akashic Records reading (personal practice, then professional practitioner training), and cacao ceremony facilitation, through live online classes, recorded lessons and a student community. She also teaches workshops on intuition, meditation writing and crystal lore for the College of Psychic Studies in London, and teaches on The Shift Network. Her books, published by Octopus, include Your Crystal Plan, The Crystal Almanac, which follows crystals through the seasons, lunar phases and festivals of the year, and Find Your Light, a guide to lightwork and intuition.
old.anamika-neitlich:
Anamika Neitlich, who writes and teaches simply as Anamika, is an American teacher of consciousness and energy work based in California. She studied psychology at Wellesley College, holds a PhD in psychology from Columbia Pacific University and is a graduate of the Barbara Brennan School of Healing. She describes perceiving energy from early childhood, and her work brings together psychology, metaphysics, spirituality and energy healing, built up over five decades of private sessions, groups and workshops with people around the world.

Her approach is invitational rather than instructional: sessions and group gatherings centre on presence, deep listening and what she calls coherence transmissions, guided energetic journeys meant to help people experience more of who they are. She works one to one and with couples by Zoom or phone, leads small shared intensive groups and a community membership, and gives a monthly online workshop on a different theme each time, sessions also being available in French. Her books include and…, Loving Now, Love in Fur Coats, about her animal companions, and French Lessons in Love, and she teaches on The Shift Network.
old.cassandra-vieten:
Cassandra Vieten is a clinical psychologist and researcher who studies spirituality, transformative experiences, mindfulness and the science of imagination. She earned her PhD in clinical psychology at the California Institute of Integral Studies and trained in behavioural genetics research at the University of California, San Francisco. She spent many years at the Institute of Noetic Sciences, serving as its President from 2013 to 2019 and remaining a Senior Fellow, and later led the John W. Brick Mental Health Foundation. She is a Clinical Professor at UC San Diego, where she directs the Center for Mindfulness.

Her teaching joins research findings with practice. In workshops at places such as Esalen, in talks and in online courses, she looks at how people change, how imagination shapes what we think, feel and do, and how meditation and contemplative practice can be brought into daily life. Her books include Imagine That, on the science of imagination; Living Deeply, a study of transformation across traditions written with Marilyn Schlitz and Tina Amorok; and Spiritual and Religious Competencies in Clinical Practice, guidelines for therapists written with Shelley Scammell. She also teaches on The Shift Network.
old.alex-dong:
Alex Dong is a fourth-generation master of the Dong (Tung) family style of Taijiquan, the lineage of his great-grandfather Dong Yingjie. He began formal training at the age of five with his father, Grand Master Dong Zeng Chen, in Hebei Province, and after moving to Honolulu at twelve he also studied with his grandfather, Grand Master Dong Hu Ling. He started assisting in his father's classes at fifteen, opened his own class in Hawaii in 1990, and in 1991 won the US national title in moving push hands. In 2003 he moved to New York City and founded the Alex Dong International Taijiquan Association.

His teaching covers the family's slow, fast, Fa-Jing and Kai-He (Hao) forms, push hands, weapons and foundational qigong, along with shorter Simplified and Advanced forms he created himself. He teaches weekly classes in New York, live and recorded lessons online, and seminars across the United States, Europe and Asia, and he sells his instructional videos through his own site. He founded the Tung Ying Jie Taiji Legacy, translated much of his great-grandfather's Taijiquan Explained (the Red Book), and co-wrote Grand Master, a biography of Dong Yingjie, with David Saltman.
old.simcha-raphael:
Simcha Paull Raphael is a rabbi, psychotherapist and teacher whose life's work brings together Jewish tradition, psychology and the study of death and the afterlife. Born in Quebec and educated at Concordia University in Montreal, he earned a PhD in psychology from the California Institute of Integral Studies in 1986 and was ordained as a Rabbinic Chaplain by Rabbi Zalman Schachter-Shalomi in 1990. He has taught at Temple University, La Salle University and Bryn Athyn College, served as a spiritual director at the Reconstructionist Rabbinical College, and works in the Philadelphia area as a transpersonal psychotherapist, bereavement counsellor and spiritual director.

He is the founding director of the DA'AT Institute for Death Awareness, Advocacy and Training, through which he gives lectures, scholar-in-residence weekends and professional trainings for clergy, hospice staff and caregivers on Jewish views of the afterlife, Kabbalah, death rituals and mourning. His best-known book, Jewish Views of the Afterlife, is now in its third edition; later books include The Grief Journey and the Afterlife, May the Angels Carry You, Living and Dying in Ancient Times and Spirits, Ghosts, & Dybbuks, along with collections of poetry.
old.lauren-rainbow:
Lauren Rainbow is an evidential medium, spiritual teacher and sacred travel guide based in New Hampshire. Her mediumship began in 2001, when a series of synchronistic events opened her to sensing and hearing loved ones in spirit, and she went on to train with a number of established mediums. Raised in community theatre, she is most at home demonstrating on stage, and she has worked alongside mediums such as Tony Stockwell and John Holland, with whom she co-wrote The Mediumship Training Deck for Hay House. She has taught at Omega Institute, Kripalu and Lily Dale.

Her work combines evidential mediumship and Akashic Soul Sessions with teaching on intuition, spirit guides and heart-centred meditation. She gives private sessions, live spirit-message evenings and meditation and sound bath events in New England, runs an online community with monthly practice circles, and sells guided meditations and Akashic Records courses. Since 2017 she has led small-group sacred journeys to Egypt, India, Peru, Nepal and Mexico. Her guided meditations are also available on Hay House Unlimited and on her YouTube channel.
old.maria-furlano:
Maria Furlano is an American Qigong teacher and energy intuitive based in Southern California. Her training began at twelve in Taekwon-Do, where she earned a second-degree black belt, and she later trained in bodywork, earned a master's degree in Traditional Oriental Medicine at Emperor's College in Los Angeles and became a licensed acupuncturist in California. She studied Qigong with Master Wan Sujian in Beijing and completed doctoral-level Qigong training through the International Institute of Medical Qigong under Bernard Shannon, where she also taught.

She is the founder of The Art Of Tuning In, an online studio where she teaches breath, movement and meditation as ways of sensing and steadying one's own energy, with particular attention to sensitive people and those who hold space for others. Her teaching covers grounding, energetic boundaries, intuition and seasonal practice rooted in Chinese tradition, offered through live classes, guided audio and private coaching. Since 2019 she has hosted The Art Of Tuning In Podcast, and she shares short Qigong routines and guided meditations on her YouTube channel. She also teaches on The Shift Network.
old.cynthia-abulafia:
Cynthia Abulafia is a writer, educator and yoga therapist in Santa Barbara, California, initiated in a Shākta Tantra lineage of the Goddess. She studied in the master's programme in yogic studies at Naropa University, has spent around two decades studying different forms of non-duality and the sacred texts of yoga and tantra, and for many years designed and led yoga teacher trainings, including as a lead trainer at Yoga Soup in Santa Barbara.

Her teaching centres on the divine feminine and on what she calls the "transcendence bias": spiritual paths that teach how to rise above the body but not how to return to it. Drawing on her own experience of kundalini awakening, she supports people through spiritual emergence with grounded practices of breath, the body, chanting and the close reading of sacred texts. Her first book, Embodying the Goddess: How to Awaken Curiosity and Reverence on the Spiritual Path, was published by Monkfish in 2026. She teaches in-person workshops in California, a streamed course on the history and texts of yoga and Goddess tantra, a free book-club course, and short talks on her YouTube channel, and writes on Substack.
old.judy-ramsey:
Judy Liu Ramsey is an animal communicator, shamanic practitioner and ordained animal chaplain who works from her farm near Ann Arbor, Michigan, under the name Heart to Heart. She holds an MA from the University of Michigan and worked as a social work counsellor and craniosacral therapist before turning to animal communication nearly twenty years ago. She trained in telepathic animal communication with Penelope Smith and in grief and hospice communication with Teresa Wagner, and her shamanic practice grew through mentoring with Sandra Ingerman and others, with further study under Tom Cowan, Alberto Villoldo and Betsy Bergstrom. She was ordained through the Compassion Consortium in 2023.

She teaches four levels of animal communication, from basic telepathic communication to interspecies counselling, and is approved by Sandra Ingerman to teach her courses, including Basic Journeying, Healing with Spiritual Light and Medicine for the Earth, and advanced practitioner trainings. Most classes run live on Zoom, alongside a twice-monthly online journey circle, private sessions for people and their animals, and small-group cultural journeys to Peru. Her approach is practical and grounded: she encourages students to become still and let the animals teach them. Her YouTube channel offers guided shamanic journeys and drumming for journeying.
old.lisa-wilcoxson:
Lisa Wilcoxson is an evidential medium and psychic based in Arizona. She says she first saw people in spirit as a teenager, but her mediumship opened fully after the deaths of both of her children: her son Michael, who had complex special needs and never walked or spoke, and later her son Anthony. Since then she has worked as a medium, and she has passed the double-blind testing and certification of Find A Certified Medium. She also works as a spiritual and grief coach and mentor.

Much of her work is with bereaved parents. She is a recommended provider and honorary board member of Helping Parents Heal and leads two of its affiliate groups, one for parents whose children with special needs have died and one for parents who have lost all or their only child. She offers individual mediumship and psychic readings online by Zoom, group readings, and talks about grief and the afterlife at events and on podcasts, and she contributed to the anthology Gathering at the Doorway. She lives in Scottsdale and Sedona with her husband, Rick.
old.kate-belew:
Kate Belew is a poet, author and teacher whose work joins creative writing with witchcraft and folk magic. She grew up in Michigan, studied English at Kalamazoo College and holds an MFA in poetry from Sarah Lawrence College. She trained in green witchcraft through a three-year apprenticeship with Robin Rose Bennett, studied herbalism with the Chestnut School of Herbs and astrology with Rebecca Gordon, and is an initiated Green Witch. She lives in Brooklyn.

She has led writing circles and workshops since 2017, in person and online. Her five-week programme The Bardo brings writers together for sessions on ritual, storytelling and channelled and automatic writing, and her Word Witch newsletter on Substack offers weekly essays and seven-line writing prompts, with live writing circles for paying members. Her book Word Witch (2025) is a guide to building a writing practice through simple rituals, and she co-wrote Wild Medicine, an illustrated guide to the folklore and magic of more than sixty herbs, with Shelby Bundy of Tamed Wild, where she co-hosted the Magick & Alchemy podcast. Her poems and essays have appeared in a range of journals and magazines.
old.helen-hamilton:
Helen Hamilton is an English spiritual teacher in the non-dual tradition of Self-realisation. Her teaching grew out of her own awakening, which she found a long and difficult process, and her aim is to make that path simpler and open to anyone; her summary of it is that the truth of our being is very simple and realisation of the Self is possible for everyone. She was long based in West Yorkshire and is a mother of four.

She teaches through satsang: a talk followed by open questions, held free on Zoom twice a month, alongside weekend intensives and residential retreats in Britain, Spain and the United States, many of them recorded. Her method rests on five practices: meditation, contemplation, self-inquiry, conscious imagining and what she calls the Statement Process. Students who want to go further join the Helen Hamilton Sangha, a monthly membership with live classes, a growing archive and support from acharya teachers she has trained. She has written a series of books published by Balboa Press, beginning with Dissolving the Ego and Transcending the Mind, and offers several short ebooks free on her website.
old.becca-tarnas:
Becca Tarnas is a scholar and teacher of archetypal cosmology, depth psychology and the imagination. She grew up in Big Sur, California, was educated at the San Francisco Waldorf School and studied environmental studies and theatre at Mount Holyoke College, before taking a master's degree in Philosophy, Cosmology and Consciousness and a PhD in Ecology, Spirituality and Religion at the California Institute of Integral Studies. Her dissertation, The Back of Beyond, compared the 'Red Books' of C.G. Jung and J.R.R. Tolkien as two journeys into the imaginal realm. She is now Assistant Professor in the Philosophy, Cosmology and Consciousness programme at CIIS.

She teaches graduate courses on Jung, archetypal astrology and the research of Stanislav Grof, and lectures widely for Jung societies and institutes, mostly online, on the Red Books, synchronicity and archetypal astrology. She is an editor of Archai: The Journal of Archetypal Cosmology and the author of Journey to the Imaginal Realm, a reader's guide to The Lord of the Rings. She narrated the audiobooks of Grof's The Way of the Psychonaut and When the Impossible Happens, and is writing his biography. She lives in the Sierra Nevada foothills of California with her family.
old.the-brothers-koren:
The Brothers Koren are Isaac and Thorald Koren, Australian-born brothers who moved to New York with their mother and spent around fifteen years as the band The Kin, earning a gold record and opening for Coldplay, P!NK, Bon Jovi and Rod Stewart. In 2015 they turned from touring to teaching, creating The Songwriter's Journey, a small-group programme that takes people with no musical background from a first idea to a finished, recorded song of their own.

Their work treats the voice as a whole-body instrument and singing as a way back to presence, self-expression and belonging. They teach through toning, breath, group singing, improvisation and songwriting, with an emphasis on play and on being heard rather than on technique. Alongside their own online programmes and the Embodied Voice Portal membership, they lead weekend workshops at Esalen, a free monthly online gathering called The Choir, and several courses on The Shift Network. They have also given a TEDx talk and co-created The Journey, a documentary about the voice.
old.gary-kraftsow:
Gary Kraftsow is an American yoga teacher who has taught in the Viniyoga tradition for more than forty years. He began studying in India with T.K.V. Desikachar in 1974, received a Viniyoga Special Diploma in Paris in 1988, and holds a master's degree in psychology and religion from the University of California, Santa Barbara. He opened a school of yoga therapy on Maui in the early 1980s and in 1999 founded the American Viniyoga Institute, which he still directs. He helped design the yoga protocols for two National Institutes of Health research studies and a workplace stress-reduction trial.

His teaching joins breath-centred āsana with prāṇāyāma, chanting, mantra and meditation, adapted to the individual, alongside the philosophy of the Yoga Sūtras, Sāṁkhya and Tantra. He leads the institute's Viniyoga Foundations Program and therapist training, an online library of live and recorded classes, and workshops and retreats in the US and abroad. He is the author of Yoga for Wellness and Yoga for Transformation, both published by Penguin, and teaches several self-paced courses on The Shift Network.
old.barry-goldstein:
Barry Goldstein is an American composer, producer and teacher who has worked with music, sound and vibration for more than thirty years. He co-produced the Grammy-winning track "69 Freedom Special" with Les Paul, has composed for film, television and PBS specials, and has made ambient soundscapes for authors and teachers including Dr. Joe Dispenza, Gregg Braden, Anita Moorjani, Neale Donald Walsch and Shirley MacLaine. Several of his albums have reached the Billboard New Age top ten.

Alongside his music he teaches people to use sound deliberately in daily life: heart-coherence breathing, toning and chanting, tuning forks, drumming, intention and personal playlists for relaxation, focus and creativity. His book, The Secret Language of the Heart, with a foreword by Dr. Joe Dispenza, sets out these tools, including the Heart Song breathing process. He teaches through online programmes on his Sound of Transformation portal, live online sound sessions and workshops, and self-paced courses on The Shift Network, and also creates sound identities for organisations through Sonic Signatures.
old.lindsey-wei:
Shifu Lindsey Wei (Daoist name Wei Cheng Ling) is an American teacher of Wudang internal martial arts and a 24th-generation lay disciple of the Chun Yang sect of Wudang Daoism. She spent more than nine years training under Master Li Xing De at the Five Immortals Temple on White Horse Mountain in China, studying Qigong, Tai Ji Quan, Ba Gua, the double-edged straight sword and Daoist meditation and scripture, before returning to the United States in 2010 to teach. Her memoir, The Valley Spirit: A Female Story of Daoist Cultivation, tells the story of those years.

Through her school, Wudang White Horse, she teaches the temple's curriculum as one path of cultivation: stillness meditation, Yang Sheng Gong, Tai Ji, Ba Gua circle walking, kung fu basics and the Seven Star Sword. Students learn through a monthly online membership with recorded courses and live weekly classes, and through residential immersion camps held outdoors in the Siskiyou mountains of southern Oregon, where training follows the rhythms of nature. The school's stated aim is to teach students how to teach themselves, so the practices become part of daily life. She also teaches self-paced Wudang Qigong and Daoist meditation courses on The Shift Network.
old.matthew-fox:
Matthew Fox is an American theologian and Episcopal priest best known for reviving Creation Spirituality, an earth-honouring mystical tradition that draws on the Western mystics, Indigenous wisdom, the arts and modern science. He earned a doctorate in the history and theology of spirituality from the Institut Catholique de Paris and was a Dominican for 34 years. He founded the Institute in Culture and Creation Spirituality, which ran at Mundelein College in Chicago and Holy Names University in Oakland, and later the University of Creation Spirituality, where he was president until 2005.

He has written more than 40 books, among them Original Blessing, The Coming of the Cosmic Christ, Creativity and A Spirituality Named Compassion, and has done much to bring Hildegard of Bingen, Meister Eckhart, Julian of Norwich and Thomas Aquinas back into wider reading. His teaching is organised around the Four Paths of Creation Spirituality: awe, letting go, creativity and transformation. He teaches recorded and live online courses, several with the cosmologist Brian Thomas Swimme or the writer Mirabai Starr, and the free Daily Meditations with Matthew Fox are written in his tradition.
old.jennifer-lisa-vest:
Dr. Jennifer Lisa Vest is an Afro-Indigenous intuitive, Akashic records reader, medium and ceremonialist based in Berkeley, California, who writes and teaches as "the Ethical Psychic". She holds a PhD in Indigenous philosophy from the University of California, Berkeley, an MA in history from Howard University and a BA in physics from Hampshire College, and taught philosophy at two universities before turning to spiritual teaching full time. She trained in Native American sweat lodge ceremony, African American Hoodoo, Caribbean spiritual healing and Spiritualism, and is a firekeeper, a Usui Reiki Master and a certified QHHT past-life regression practitioner.

She founded Metatron's Academy of Spirit and Science, an online school with self-paced courses on auras, the Akashic records and psychic development, and teaches regularly on The Shift Network. Her book The Ethical Psychic is a beginner's guide to working with intuitive gifts with integrity, and Sovereign Wisdom, from her academic career, proposes ways to build Native American philosophy from Indigenous cultures. On YouTube she talks about spirit guides, ancestors, mediumship and the Akashic records, alongside psychic commentary on current events.
old.renee-baribeau:
Renee Baribeau, known as The Practical Shaman, is an American shamanic practitioner, author and teacher with around three decades of practice. She has drawn on teachings from Q'ero, Lakota, Mapuche and other Andean traditions, and since 2010 has taught her own system, WindWork, at festivals such as Bhakti Fest and Shakti Fest, at Omega and online. WindWork treats the winds as a compass for times of change: students learn to read four primary winds and the gates between them, and to use ceremony, journeying and simple rituals such as wind knots and prayer flags in everyday life.

Her Hay House book Winds of Spirit won a Nautilus Gold award, and she has since published A Pilgrim's Guide to Walking Wisdom and the 64-card Wind Walker's Wisdom Oracle; a further book, The Practical Shaman, is due from Destiny Books in 2027. She teaches through on-demand courses and monthly online journey circles on windwork.org, leads walking pilgrimages, and offers two WindWork courses on The Shift Network. She co-hosts The Shaman's Cave podcast with Sandra Ingerman and hosts her own podcast, The Practical Shaman.
old.melissa-kim-corter:
Melissa Kim Corter is a depth psychologist and writer whose work centres on the shadow side of the psyche. She holds a master's degree and a doctorate in depth psychology, with an emphasis on Jungian and archetypal studies, from Pacifica Graduate Institute, where her doctoral thesis examined psychopathy and the Western shadow. She also trained as a hypnotherapist at the Southwest Institute of Healing Arts, is an ordained minister and a certified medicolegal death investigator, and sits on the board of the International Association for Jungian Studies.

Her teaching uses fairy tales, myth, film, dreams and journaling to help people meet the hidden and disowned parts of themselves rather than turn away from them. She runs self-paced programmes on Jungian shadow work, soulful writing and the dark feminine, offers private consultations for writers and creatives, and writes a Substack called The Shadow Psychologist. Her books include Apothecary for the Afflicted, a collection of shadow work practices, Esoterica: The Shadow Worker's Codex, and the Wild Woman's book series. On The Shift Network she teaches courses on the myths of the dark goddess and on the alchemy of fairy tales.
old.richard-tarnas:
Richard Tarnas is a cultural historian and philosopher whose work brings together the history of ideas, depth psychology and archetypal astrology. He is Professor Emeritus at the California Institute of Integral Studies in San Francisco, where he founded the Philosophy, Cosmology, and Consciousness programme and taught for some thirty years, covering the evolution of consciousness, Jungian and archetypal psychology and archetypal cosmology. Before that he spent ten years at Esalen Institute in Big Sur, where he became director of programmes and education, and he has lectured regularly at Pacifica Graduate Institute.

His book The Passion of the Western Mind traces Western thought from ancient Greece to the postmodern era and is widely used in universities. Cosmos and Psyche: Intimations of a New World View sets out the case for correlations between planetary cycles and archetypal patterns in history and in individual lives, and received the Book of the Year Prize from the Scientific and Medical Network. He also wrote Prometheus the Awakener, an essay on the archetype of Uranus. A past president of the International Transpersonal Association, he now teaches mainly online, including courses with the Kosmos Institute and, with Stanislav Grof, the Psyche & Cosmos programmes on The Shift Network.
old.cyndi-dale:
Cyndi Dale is an American intuitive energy healer, author and teacher based in Minnesota. She studied English and philosophy, worked towards a master's degree in divinity at Bethel University, and trained in shamanism, Therapeutic Touch, intuitive healing and the Lakota Way. Over several decades she has given private intuitive sessions to tens of thousands of clients and led workshops across the Americas, Europe, Africa and China.

Her teaching centres on the subtle body: an expanded twelve-chakra system, the auric fields, kundalini and the energetic boundaries between people. She has written more than 40 books, published in some 20 languages, including The Subtle Body: An Encyclopedia of Your Energetic Anatomy, Llewellyn's Complete Book of Chakras and Energetic Boundaries. Cyndi teaches through self-paced video courses on The Shift Network, her own online classes and audio programmes, and small in-person retreats, mixing clear explanation with guided meditations and practical exercises for developing intuition and working with energy.
old.philip-carr-gomm:
Philip Carr-Gomm is an English writer, psychologist and teacher of Druidry who lives on the South Downs in Sussex. He began studying Druidry in his teens with Ross Nichols, founder of the Order of Bards, Ovates and Druids, and in 1988 was asked to lead the Order, which he guided for more than three decades as it grew into one of the largest Druid groups in the world. He took a degree in psychology at University College London and trained in psychosynthesis psychotherapy, play therapy, Montessori education and sophrology, and later as a teacher of Yoga Nidra and mindfulness meditation.

His teaching brings together nature spirituality, Western psychology and the wider perennial wisdom tradition. He uses conversation, plant and animal oracles, storytelling, poetry, meditation and ritual. He has written or co-written some 20 books, including Druid Mysteries, The Book of English Magic and, with his wife Stephanie, The Druid Animal Oracle and The DruidCraft Tarot. He teaches through online courses on his own platforms and The Shift Network, his long-running YouTube series Tea with a Druid, talks and workshops, and he founded the Sophrology Institute.
old.robert-moss:
Robert Moss is a dream teacher, author and storyteller, born in Australia, and the creator of Active Dreaming, his own blend of modern dreamwork and shamanic practice. As a child he went through three near-death experiences, which he describes as his first openings to other realms and later wrote about in his memoir The Boy Who Died and Came Back. He was a lecturer in ancient history at the Australian National University and has worked as a journalist, poet and independent scholar.

Active Dreaming treats dreams as real experiences and as journeys, not only as material to be analysed. Moss teaches dream re-entry, conscious dream travel, sharing dreams in small groups, and paying attention to signs and synchronicity in waking life, which he calls kairomancy. He has written more than a dozen books, among them Conscious Dreaming, Dreamgates, The Secret History of Dreaming, Sidewalk Oracles and Growing Big Dreams. He leads workshops internationally, runs a three-year training for teachers of Active Dreaming, and has recorded many self-paced dreamwork courses with The Shift Network, covering lucid dreaming, shamanic dreaming, ancient dream traditions and dreaming about death and the afterlife.
old.rebecca-dawson:
Rebecca Dawson is an Australian channel, author and teacher who has worked with channelled material for more than thirty years. She began speaking as a channel at the age of eighteen, and her teachings are presented as coming from a group she calls the Masters, among them Serapis Bey, St Germain and Kuthumi. Her themes include the shift in human consciousness, the nature of time and dimensional reality, purpose and conscious creation.

She is the author of four books, The New Human Experience, The Game of Purpose, The Agreement and Fu: The Return of the Magnetic Human. She teaches mainly online through livestream series, recorded seminars with transcripts, a monthly membership with live question-and-answer sessions and wisdom circles, and occasional in-person retreats and expo appearances. She also offers private channelled sessions over Zoom, has contributed articles to the Sedona Journal of Emergence, and has been a guest on many podcasts. In 2026 she taught a seven-week live course on perception on The Shift Network.
old.yuval-ron:
Yuval Ron is an Israeli-born composer, oud player and teacher of sacred music, based in Los Angeles. He leads the Yuval Ron Ensemble, which brings together Jewish, Sufi, Christian and Armenian musical traditions, and he has written scores for film, dance and theatre, including the Oscar-winning short West Bank Story. Since 1990, when he composed binaural music for the Monroe Institute, he has worked with neuroscientists, healers and spiritual teachers on music for meditation and wellbeing, and he founded the Metta Mindfulness Music label and the Inspired Sound Initiative, a non-profit offering arts programmes to young people.

His teaching draws on the sacred sound practices of several traditions: Sufi chanting and zikr, Kabbalistic and Hebrew prayer, Nada Yoga, Qi Gong's six healing sounds and Middle Eastern musical modes, alongside research on how sound affects the brain. He has taught at the Esalen Institute since 2009 and lectured at universities such as Yale, MIT, UCLA and Berklee. His book Divine Attunement: Music as a Path to Wisdom, with a foreword by Pir Zia Inayat-Khan, tells stories of mystics and musicians from many faiths and won an Indie Book Award in 2015. On The Shift Network he teaches a course on Sufi mystical sound traditions.
old.shamini-jain:
Dr. Shamini Jain is an American clinical psychologist, researcher and teacher whose work brings together scientific research and spiritual practice. She studied neuroscience at Columbia University, earned her doctorate in clinical psychology through the joint programme of the University of California, San Diego and San Diego State University, and completed postdoctoral training at UCLA. She is an adjunct professor in family medicine at UC San Diego and founded the Consciousness and Healing Initiative, a non-profit that brings scientists, practitioners, educators and artists together to study the biofield and the practice of healing.

Alongside her research she trained in energy work with Rev. Rosalyn Bruyere and draws on the Jain, Vedic and Tantric traditions. Her teaching combines short summaries of the research with guided meditation, mantra, chanting and voice work, and she often uses sound and song, having released an album, Kaliyuga Blues. Her book Healing Ourselves: Biofield Science and the Future of Health was published by Sounds True. She has taught at Esalen, the Omega Institute and the Sivananda Ashram in the Bahamas, and teaches self-paced courses online through The Shift Network.
